metadata.title: CNAB 444 Status Checker
metadata.description: Upload a CNAB 444 remittance file and check the status of each invoice.

home.title: CNAB 444 Status Checker

layout.title: CNAB 444 layout
layout.intro: CNAB 444 is the remittance file used to assign receivables to funds, securitization companies and factoring firms. Each line is a record of {length} columns: the CNAB 400 collection layout plus the access key of the NF-e (Brazilian electronic invoice) backing each receivable, at {keyPositions}.
layout.docLink: Full layout documentation in the repository

records.title: Record types
records.description: Column 1 of each line tells the record type.

header.name: Header
header.description: First line: identifies the remittance, the company and the recording date.

detail.name: Detail
detail.description: One line per receivable: control number, due date, amount, payer and NF-e key.

trailer.name: Trailer
trailer.recordCount: Line count at {positions}; in the sample, left-aligned at {samplePositions}, followed by blanks.

xray.title: One sample detail, column by column
xray.description: First detail of the challenge file, with a fictitious payer. Columns between fields are not highlighted.
xray.label: Sample detail line with the fields highlighted
xray.caption: Solid color and underline: stable columns. Outline: positions observed in the sample.

table.title: Detail fields
table.observedNote: Only the record type and the NF-e key have guaranteed positions, and only they are used for extraction. The other positions were observed in the sample and are not guaranteed: in detail 2, for instance, every field from the control number on is one column to the right.
table.caption: Fields of the first sample detail

accessKey.title: Access key anatomy
accessKey.description: The NF-e key has 44 digits and encodes the invoice behind the receivable. It identifies each item in the status check.
